text:
maya_csm: Kicking off Sunflow Labs pilot onboarding — quick intro: Elena (product lead) + Sam (infra) are our primary customer contacts. Objective: embed Redwood embeddings + chat layer to power support routing. Target: pilot live in ~30 days.

jonathan_se: Are they strictly GCP? affects connector choices and whether we recommend Hosted vs Dedicated.

maya_csm: GCP us-central primary; they have a small staging AWS account. Recommend hosted for speed, discuss Dedicated if latency/cost concerns surface.

kevin_enablement: I'll run enablement. Proposal: 2 customer sessions — "Intro & runbook" and "Prompting + evals". Ask: who from Sunflow should join?

maya_csm: Elena + Sam + 1 eng mgr + 1 data engineer. Proposed slots: week of Apr 7 and Apr 14.

zoe_successops: Risk flag: pilot budget is constrained; renewal signal weak. Set two escalation triggers: <50% planned test traffic by D14 OR eval QA <80%. We'll surface weekly traction to execs.

jonathan_se: Quick tech checklist:
- API keys & IP allowlist
- Anonymized sample dataset export
- Test prompts + golden answers
- p95 latency target: <350ms in staging

maya_csm: Timeline: Day 0 kickoff; D0–D7 env prep + keys + data transfer; D8–D14 integration + smoke tests; D15–D21 enablement + eval runs; D22–D30 polish + go/no-go decision.

kevin_enablement: I'll share a runbook template and short pre-read before the first workshop.

jonathan_se: Can Sunflow provide a small traffic replay (10k requests) for staging latency tests?

onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Sunflow Pilot Kickoff" 2024-04-01 16:00 PDT — invites sent to maya_csm, jonathan_se, kevin_enablement, elena_sunflow.

maya_csm: Success criteria (confirm please): integration with sample data; >=80% correctness on eval set; p95 <350ms under typical load; team can run daily evals and detect regressions.

zoe_successops: Add D30 checkpoint decision (go/no-go + recommended commercial path). Weekly traction report owner: zoe_successops.

maya_csm: Owners: integration=jonathan_se; enablement=kevin_enablement; metrics/reporting=zoe_successops; CSM=maya_csm.

kevin_enablement: I'll prep pre-read + invite content requests.

jonathan_se: I'll post curl examples + test harness tonight.

maya_csm: Action recap: jonathan_se = curl + harness (EOD); kevin = runbook + pre-read (Mon); zoe = weekly report template + dashboard draft (Wed); maya = finalize agenda + invites (EOD).

jonathan_se: ack.

kevin_enablement: ack.

zoe_successops: ack, adding risk flags to dashboard.

maya_csm: Thanks everyone — I'll drop the kickoff notes and shared checklist after the meeting :raised_hands:
